clips.title: The story
paras: Near the Grizzled Den, Rumbleshot's Ammo lies abandoned in the snow. The crate was bound for gunsmith Hegnar Rumbleshot in Dun Morogh, but a frightened courier fled from hungry wendigos and left it behind.

Hegnar Rumbleshot keeps a roadside arms shop on the mountain path from Coldridge Pass toward Anvilmar. Ironforge riflemen, mountaineers, and dwarven mortar teams drill in the snowy heights, and his supplies run low as quickly as powder burns. Loslor sent this shipment of shot from Kharanos, but it never reached the shelves. Its courier camped too close to the Grizzled Den's wendigos. When they attacked, the courier panicked and fled, leaving the heavy crate in the beasts' hunting grounds.
